scope: Declared implementation and installation requirements; not a runtime availability probe or physical acceptance certificate.

requirements: Host-installed PlatformIO Core and selected platform/toolchain packages
backends.installation: Install PlatformIO Core explicitly, then install the project's selected platform and framework packages through authorized PlatformIO operations.
limits: Project scripts and package hooks execute host code under their respective permissions.
OTA supports configured ESP32/ESP8266 firmware/filesystem paths; physical release acceptance remains pending.

requirements: Selected PlatformIO toolchain addr2line, nm and size utilities
backends.installation: Install the selected PlatformIO platform/toolchain explicitly; tool paths are resolved from trusted installed packages.
limits: ELF identity is not proof of firmware running on the device.
Static sizes are not runtime heap or stack measurements.

requirements: Matching firmware ELF and architecture-specific GDB
Host Python interpreter outside the project
backends.installation: Explicitly provision the pinned esp-coredump dependency and matching GDB; set PIO_MCP_COREDUMP_PYTHON and PIO_MCP_COREDUMP_GDB on the server.
limits: Unknown or encrypted formats are rejected.
Device retrieval requires independent hardware permission.

backends.installation: Explicitly install the selected PlatformIO debug packages and host USB drivers. Configure the project debug environment and tool.
limits: Owned local loopback TCP backends only.
ST-Link probes through OpenOCD are implemented; standalone st-util, remote and pipe backend custody remain unsupported.

requirements: Packaged serialport native binding for the host platform
Host serial device access and an unambiguous device selection
backends.installation: Install a supported runtime package and the board's required host drivers; do not change OS permissions automatically.
limits: Opening can reset hardware and is separately authorized from reading and writing.
Serial power values are firmware estimates, not external meter measurements.

requirements: Nordic PPK2 and an explicitly bound DUT
backends.installation: Run scripts/setup-ppk2.py with a new dedicated environment directory, then set PIO_MCP_PPK2_ENV on the server to that directory.
limits: Mode and source voltage/current envelope require explicit selection and authorization.
Software overcurrent handling is not a hardware current limiter.
Physical measurement and output-off release acceptance remain pending.
